name: F5-TTS
tagline: Zero-shot diffusion-based text-to-speech and voice cloning system that replicates speaker tone from short audio samples.
real_test_summary: Tested cloning a custom narrator voice locally from a 10-second clean WAV reference clip. Matches cadence and vocal timbre offline through a simple Gradio interface or CLI.
pros: Zero-shot voice cloning requires only a 5-to-15-second reference audio clip
Runs locally on 4GB VRAM GPUs with Gradio web UI and ComfyUI nodes
MIT open-source license with no character limits or usage caps
cons: Output quality depends heavily on noise-free reference audio and accurate transcription
Slower inference speed than lightweight non-diffusion engines like Piper or Kokoro
